scientific_integrity: An exact all-parameter relative-homology proof establishes the claim. Finite signed cellular calculations are corroborative only. The symmetry quotient consequence is rational, not integral.
scientific_limitations: Determines the integral S_n-action on ordinary degree-two homology for NM_2(n), n>=4, but not equivariant homotopy type, higher k, or independent publication priority. Distinct nonmatching and ordinary matching complexes.
title: The integral \(S_n\)-module of the two-matching-avoidance complex
